facts.business: Anik Industries Limited operates in multiple jurisdictions and is subject to periodic challenges by local tax authorities on a range of tax matters including direct and indirect tax matters.
key_risks: The Company operates in multiple jurisdictions and is subject to periodic challenges by local tax authorities on a range of tax matters during the normal course of business including direct and indirect tax matters.
facts.related_party_note: During the year under review the Company has advance loan of Rs. 3159.96 Lakhs to its material subsidiary Revera Milk & Foods Private Limited, in compliance with the provisions of section 185 and 186 of the Companies Act, 2013 and with the approval of members obtained in the 49th Annual General Meeting of the Company; To continue the term of Corporate Guarantee of the Company for obtaining various credit limits/facilities by RMFPL from Banks/Financial Institutions upto an amount not exceeding Rs. 100,00,00,000/- (Rupees Hundred Crores Only)
